215-4885-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-4885-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

147-1854-5147.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-5147.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2393-3249-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2841-6529.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-6529.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1174-1479-7885.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-7885.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

884-1594-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-1594-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1987-3110-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3110-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3110-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4872-7487-7631.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Zealous Lorecaster
When the Zealous Lorecaster token enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4499-7356-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

457-4742-5159-5491.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm that is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform, and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Map, adding {U}.
Activate Mishra's Warform by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it and a Map token for each Mishra's Warform and/or Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-4742-5159-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

3459-4474-5078-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3814-5056-6871.description:
Give the artifact type to Argothian Elder using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

549-1355-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
549-1355-1978.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sanctum Weaver.
Repeat

1482-2866-4050-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1322-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1387-1500-2100-5195-5644.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Storm-Kiln Artist, Blood Funnel and Judith trigger.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a 2/2 Imp creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Imp.
When the Imp dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

2457-5794-6705-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Frog and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

3719-6188-6307-6797--85.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five creatures, excluding Fear of Missing Out, that have total power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block and kill Fear of Missing Out or Luxurious Locomotive.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
3719-6188-6307-6797--85.description:
Activate Luxurious Locomotive's crew ability by tapping five creatures you control with total power 1 or greater, causing Luxurious Locomotive to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Luxurious Locomotive and Fear of Missing Out as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Luxurious Locomotive trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out trigger, untapping Luxurious Locomotive and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

510-2281-2438.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

148-1339-5719.notablePrerequisites:
Keen Sense attached to Molten Gatekeeper.
You have a way to draw a card.
148-1339-5719.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Molten Gatekeeper, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-3277-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
1987-3277-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-5147-5263.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 3, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

122-1496-1734-5147.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

719-876-2525-4302-4951.notablePrerequisites:
"Angel" chosen with Xenograft.
Your life total is at least four.
719-876-2525-4302-4951.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
When Priest of Fell Rites dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Priest of Fell Rites ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Body Double enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Body Double.
Activate Body Double by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it.
 When Body Double dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Priest of Fell Rites from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Fell Rites enters the battlefield, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Repeat.

1124-1677-2032-2034-4450.description:
Activate Chandra's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Elementals, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kiora by removing zero loyalty counters from it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

152-1283-2719-4772.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery copies first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' second abilities to draw infinite cards.

292-4629-4831.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to add {R}.
You have the highest life total.
292-4629-4831.description:
Activate the permanent by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Cacophodon and Rite of Passage trigger.
Resolve the Rite of Passage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Cacophodon trigger, untapping the permanent that can produce {R}.
Repeat.

1155-3263.description:
Cast Consulate Crackdown by paying {5}.
Consulate Crackdown enters the battlefield, exiling all permanents your opponent control until Consulate Crackdown leaves the battlefield.

2050-3525-3553.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Nature's Embrace attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3525-3553.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Nature's Embrace, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.

216-1193-4095.notablePrerequisites:
There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {6}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
You control at least two artifacts, reduced by one for every two artifacts controlled by opponents.
216-1193-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Metallurgic Summonings.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Metallurgic Summonings triggers, creating a 5/5 Construct artifact creature token.
Resolve Radiate, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna besides the original, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target, bringing the total number of artifacts you control to at least six.
Activate any copy of Metallurgic Summonings by paying {3}{U}{U}, returning all instant and sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {6}{U}{U}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 4 each repetition.
